subject: POC qualification and ownership gap map
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medtechco.com>, Gustavo Alvarez <gustavo@medtechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap: discovery & POC qualification — next steps

Thanks for the call today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the POC scope and owners. Highlights below; please correct anything I missed.

Proposed POC scope (3-week pilot):
- Workload: in-app ranking + embedding-powered search for clinical docs (sample set ~50k docs)
- Success criteria (suggested):
  - Latency: 95th percentile < 200ms for ranking calls under target load
  - Throughput: sustain 5 rps steady-state for end-to-end requests
  - Embedding similarity: top-5 relevance precision >= 0.78 on our seed prompt set
  - Data controls: no PHI persisted outside your VPC; audit logs for requests retained 90 days
- Timeline: week 0 (kickoff & infra access), week 1 (integration + baseline), week 2 (benchmarking & tuning), week 3 (validation + handoff)

Open questions we flagged on the call:
- Which environment do you want us to run in for the POC (hosted redwood API, Redwood Dedicated reserved pool, or Private on-prem package)?
- Who owns infra/network provisioning vs app-level integration vs security approval vs procurement signatures on your side?

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm the success criteria (or propose edits)
2) Share contact(s) for owners in infra, app, security, procurement (name + email)
3) Quick 30-min alignment next week to assign action owners and confirm access.

I attached an initial POC outline for reference (initial-poc-outline.pdf).

Thanks — happy to adapt criteria once I have owners and access details.

—
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0123
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medtechco.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Gustavo Alvarez <gustavo@medtechco.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Mar 2027 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery & POC qualification — next steps

Thanks Chloe — great summary. I confirmed owners on our side below:
- Infra / cloud: Gustavo Alvarez (CTO) <gustavo@medtechco.com>
- App owner / product: Priya Shah <priya.shah@medtechco.com>
- Security / compliance: Maria Lopez (InfoSec Lead) <maria.lopez@medtechco.com>
- Procurement / contracting: Karen White <procurement@medtechco.com>

A few adjustments from our side:
- Data residency: we need logs and models to remain within us-east-1 for the pilot (we can discuss Trusted Private later).
- Audit logs: retention needs to be exportable for internal audit; please confirm export format and retention SLA.
- Benchmarks: can we add correctness checks for hallucination rate on extractive QA prompts (target < 5% false assertions)?

I attached our SOC2 questionnaire we typically use for vendors (SOC2-questions.xlsx) — security will want to walk through it before signoff.

We are leaning towards Redwood Dedicated for predictable latency, but Gustavo wants to hear whether Redwood would operate the Dedicated pool (managed) during the POC or whether we stitch into Hosted with a Dedicated fallback. Could you confirm?

Happy to do the 30-min alignment — Wed or Thu next week works for us.

Best,
Elena
Director of Product, MedTechCo
elenaruiz@medtechco.com
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@medtechco.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 02 Mar 2027 09:13:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: discovery & POC qualification — next steps

Appreciate the clarifications, Elena — helpful. Below I mapped proposed owners (Redwood + MedTechCo) and a lean RACI-style grid so we can spot gaps. Please confirm or correct.

Proposed owner assignments (Redwood / MedTechCo):
- Infra provisioning & VPC peering: MedTechCo (Gustavo) — Redwood point: Ben Carter (integration lead)
- Runtime config & benchmarking: Redwood (Aditya Rao) — MedTechCo review: Priya Shah
- Security questionnaire & compliance gating: MedTechCo (Maria Lopez) — Redwood point: Monica Patel (legal & compliance)
- Procurement & SOW signatures: MedTechCo (Karen White) — Redwood point: Monica Patel
- Success criteria validation & acceptance: Joint (Priya + Aditya) — Customer acceptance sign-off: Elena

Quick RACI snapshot (R=responsible, A=approver, C=consulted, I=informed):
- Infra access: R=Gustavo (MedTechCo), A=Gustavo, C=Ben, I=Aditya
- Runtime perf tuning: R=Aditya (Redwood), A=Ben, C=Priya, I=Elena
- Security review: R=Maria (MedTechCo), A=Maria, C=Monica, I=Gustavo
- Contract sign: R=Karen (MedTechCo), A=Karen, C=Monica, I=Chloe

Action items from Redwood (will pick up once owners confirmed):
- Update POC plan with data residency and audit export spec (action: Aditya)
- Share Dedicated vs Hosted POC pros/cons + ops model (managed vs self-service) by EOD tomorrow (action: Ben)
- Schedule 30-min alignment meeting (action: Chloe) — proposed times below; please pick one:
  - Wed 03/03 10:00–10:30 PT
  - Wed 03/03 14:00–14:30 PT
  - Thu 03/04 09:00–09:30 PT

I attached an updated owner grid (poc-owner-grid.xlsx) and will follow up with the Dedicated vs Hosted ops note.

On the Dedicated question: short answer — for pilots we can operate a managed Dedicated pool (Redwood-managed) so you get reserved capacity without needing to run infra; we can discuss longer-term handoffs in the handoff/ops chapter. Ben will send a short doc that lists the tradeoffs.

—
Chloe
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
